invariants.title: The people are these people
invariants.rule: TOMAS, from their packs, are in the start picture; no one else.
invariants.why: identity comes from the composited anchor, not from the engine's prior

invariants.title: The place is cafe-morning
invariants.rule: The background is the cafe-morning plate dawn_wide and stays that place for the whole take.
invariants.why: words that name what the plate lacks make the engine rewrite it

invariants.title: Camera: crash zoom
invariants.rule: The camera slams in and rings - the engine is asked to hold still and the move is done by the studio after the render, then measured.
invariants.why: an engine cannot be asked for a camera move (measured: a locked-off sentence still pushed in 3 of 3); arithmetic can

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: resolution and length trade inside a fixed envelope
